definitions.explanation: The value or result gained from an action or effort. Often used in set phrases to express whether something was worthwhile or had the desired effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}した→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧{甲斐|かい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甲斐|かい}⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to all the practice, we won the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甲斐|かい}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: Despite treatment, the patient passed away.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{甲斐|かい} typically appears in two key patterns:
- ～⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{甲斐|かい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ — it was worth doing ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甲斐|かい}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ — despite ~, in vain
- ～{甲斐|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — worth doing (as a suffix, voiced to がい)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {生|い}き{甲斐|がい} (いきがい) — purpose in life, reason for living
- やり{甲斐|がい} — worth doing, rewarding
- {働|はたら}き{甲斐|がい} — job satisfaction, worth working

USAGE:
When used as a suffix attached to verb stems, the reading changes to がい (voiced): やり{甲斐|がい}, {生|い}き{甲斐|がい}.
